data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root word ‘raww’, meaning ‘to flow’. This name is often given to babies born near a river or a body of water, symbolizing the constant flow of life. The name Rowa carries the meaning “Flow” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu. Parents who choose Rowa usually hope their child will grow to embody flow and live with faith, good character and purpose.
